# Yen carry — report

**Slug:** `family-yen-carry`  
**Dev:** 12.29% CAGR / 72.99% DD / 0.48 Sharpe, 311 fills.  
**Full:** 18.21% CAGR / 71.47% DD / 0.59 Sharpe, 399 fills.  

USDJPY 40-session direction: positive -> TQQQ, negative -> BIL. The family is
active but well below the TQQQ CAGR bar; it is a low-correlation FX research
record, not a winner. The full holdout was 36.87% CAGR with a 36.71% drawdown.
hypothesis_md:
# Yen carry / safe-haven impulse

**Slug:** `family-yen-carry`  
**Family:** yen-carry  
**Primary object:** USDJPY 40-session change.

A sharply stronger yen is a global carry-unwind/safe-haven signal; a stable or
rising USDJPY supports risk appetite. Hold TQQQ when the 40-session USDJPY
change is positive, BIL when negative. Signal at close; next-open fill;
long-only, 2% band, 1 bp headline.
